Castello di Velona Resort Val d'Orcia, Book on the Official Website
The Thermal Castle Of Val D'orcia
A thousand years of history, a natural thermal spring and the timeless beauty of Tuscany.
Perched on a hilltop overlooking the UNESCO-listed Val d'Orcia, Castello di Velona is a thousand-year-old fortress bathed in Tuscan light. Beneath the estate flows a natural thermal spring that feeds the panoramic pools of the spa: this is what makes it a true Thermal Castle.
All around, hectares of private estate: Brunello vineyards, olive groves, woodlands and hills that change colour with every hour of the day. Within, 45 refined suites, three restaurants, an estate cantina and the silence of the campagna toscana.
Here, you don't visit Tuscany. You inhabit it.
Enter the Castle

Excursions and Experiences in the heart of Tuscany
Luxury experiences of real Tuscan life
Private wine tastings, cooking classes, hot air balloon flights, vineyard picnics, helicopter tours and sunsets over the Val d'Orcia.
Every experience at Castello di Velona is designed to reveal the most authentic, refined and unforgettable side of Tuscany.
Discover all our Experiences
The Olispa Termale
Relax in the warmest thermal waters of the Val d'Orcia
OLISPA is a contemporary wellness sanctuary shaped by Tuscan travertine and immersed in the silence of the Val d'Orcia. Over 1,500 sqm are dedicated to relaxation, featuring panoramic thermal pools, a sauna, steam baths, sensory showers and rituals inspired by the Tuscan territory.
Dip in the thermal waters
Gourmet Experiences
Moments to taste
From panoramic breakfasts to gourmet dinners at sunset, the culinary experience at Castello di Velona celebrates Tuscan tradition through a contemporary perspective.
Seasonal ingredients, regional cuisine, renowned wines from Montalcino and intimate atmospheres accompany every moment of the day.
Taste Tuscany at the Castle
Panoramic terraces, timeless atmospheres and the authentic elegance of a thousand-year-old castle.
Castello di Velona is the ideal destination for exclusive weddings, private events, retreats and meetings immersed in the most iconic beauty of Tuscany.

pages.text:
Discover the FAQ on Castello di Velona official website
Home
FAQ
FAQ
GENERAL INFORMATION
What time is check-in and check-out?
Check-in from 4:00 PM
Check-out by 12:00 PM
What are the reception opening hours?
The reception is open 24 hours a day.
What languages are spoken at reception?
Italian, English, French, and Spanish.
Where is Castello di Velona located and how can it be reached?
The property is located in Castelnuovo dell'Abate, 10 minutes from Montalcino, in the Val d'Orcia. It can be reached by train, arriving at Buonconvento station, or by car, and is only 1 hour and 45 minutes from Florence.
Is parking available at Castello di Velona?
Yes, parking is available.
Does Castello di Velona have an elevator?
Yes.
What accessibility features does Castello di Velona offer?
An elevator is available.
Does the property have Wi-Fi?
Yes, of course.
Are pets allowed?
Yes, pets are accepted with an additional supplement.
Is luggage storage available?
Yes.
What amenities are offered in the rooms?
Coffee machine, kettle, shaving kit, speaker, toothbrush, earplugs, sewing kit, adapter, Wi-Fi, PressReader.
Is there a city tax?
A city tax is required in accordance with the regulations of the Municipality of Montalcino.
Which credit cards are accepted for payment?
Mastercard, Visa, American Express.
CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT
How does check-in work at Castello di Velona?
Check-in is available either at the property or online.
Is early check-in possible?
It is possible upon request and subject to availability.
Is late check-out possible?
It is possible upon request and subject to availability.
What are the reception opening hours?
The reception is open 24 hours a day.
PROPERTY & SERVICES
Is there a shuttle service to/from Castello di Velona?
Yes, a paid shuttle service is available.
Is there an electric vehicle charging service?
Yes, we have paid charging stations.
Can children stay at Castello di Velona?
Children of all ages are welcome at the property.
Does Castello di Velona have a private beach/beach club?
No.
Do you provide beach towels?
No.
ROOMS
Are cribs and children's beds available?
Yes.
Do you have accessible rooms?
We have accessible rooms.
BREAKFAST
Is breakfast included?
Yes, breakfast is included.
What time is breakfast served?
From 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM.
Where is breakfast served?
At the Settimo Senso restaurant.
What type of breakfast is served?
Continental buffet and la carte.
Are gluten-free, vegetarian, and vegan options available?
Yes.
RESTAURANTS & BAR
Is there a restaurant at Castello di Velona?
There are three restaurants on the property.
Are gluten-free, vegetarian, and vegan options available?
Yes.
Is there a bar on the property?
Yes.
SPA, POOL & GYM
Is there a Spa/Wellness Center at Castello di Velona?
Yes, Olispa is available: a thermal and spa center of over 1,500 square meters.
What are the Spa/Wellness Center opening hours?
The spa is open from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
Do you provide a Spa/Wellness Center kit?
Guests are provided with bathrobes and slippers.
Is there a swimming pool at Castello di Velona?
There are five swimming pools on the property: two indoor, two outdoor and one private outdoor pool.
What are the swimming pool opening hours?
The pool is open 24 hours a day.
Do you provide pool towels?
Yes.
Is there a gym at Castello di Velona?
Yes.
What are the gym opening hours?
The gym is always open.
ACTIVITIES, EXPERIENCES & EVENTS
Does Castello di Velona offer a concierge service?
Yes.
Do you organize tours and excursions in the surrounding area?
Yes, we offer over 50 experiences.
Is it possible to organize weddings or private events?
It is possible to organize weddings as well as private and corporate events.

pages.text:
Find out more about Castello di Velona's History
Home
Castle
History
History
More than a thousand years of Tuscan heritage.
Overlooking the valley crossed by the ancient Via Clodia, which connected southern Etruria to Rome, Castello di Velona was built as a military fortress between the 11th and 12th centuries, in a strategic position at the top of the hill. From its origins it had a singular nature: not a fief with a lord, but a Consortium of Arts and Crafts, governed by the master artisans who lived and worked within its walls.
Expanded in the 12th century, during the rise of the Aldobrandeschi counts in Val d'Orcia, the Castle preserves from that era its Watch Tower, a memory of the ancient rivalry between Siena and Florence. In the 15th century it passed to the Medici, who made it a noble residence; the main Loggia dates to the Renaissance, and "Velona" even appears in the geographical maps frescoed in the Vatican by cosmographer Ignazio Danti. The Cervini family followed in the 18th century and, at the end of the 19th, Count Martelli, whose insignia can still be read on the central tower.
After a century of silence, in 1997 the Piermartini family brought the Castle back to life, restoring it from ruin to dimora. And among the vines came the discovery that changed everything: a natural thermal spring, which turned the fortress into a thermal castle.
The legend of Velona
It is said that Totila, king of the Ostrogoths, stopped at Velona on his march through Tuscany and fell in love with a princess promised to another. To escape him, she turned to Apollo, who revealed to her in a dream the secret of the warm waters flowing near the castle: immersing herself, she became a spring of pure, crystalline water. Ever since, they say, that water has been considered a source of healing and wellbeing the same water that flows through the Castle's pools today.

How to reach us
By car
Reaching Castello di Velona means travelling through some of Tuscany's most iconic landscapes. Nestled in the heart of the UNESCO-listed Val d'Orcia, the Resort is located just minutes from Montalcino and can be easily reached from Italy's major cities via the A1 motorway. The final stretch winds through rolling hills, Brunello vineyards and historic villages, offering a memorable introduction to the experience that awaits.
By train
The railway stations of Benevento, Siena and Grosseto provide convenient connections to the Val d'Orcia from major Italian destinations. Upon request, our Concierge team will be delighted to arrange a private transfer directly to the Resort, ensuring a seamless and comfortable journey.
By plane
Florence, Pisa and Rome international airports offer the most convenient access to Castello di Velona. For guests seeking the ultimate in exclusivity, the Resort also features a private helipad, allowing for a spectacular arrival above the rolling hills of Val d'Orcia and the renowned Brunello di Montalcino vineyards.
